conviction_note: First results of the enlarged (post-Picton) trust: the 30 Sep NAV and the promised strategy update are new, so abs_move is set at 3.0 (above this low-vol trust's 0.4-3.8% results-day history, per the understatement lesson), but the evidence is balanced: a modest NAV dip from CBRE's -0.9% Q3 capital values and deal costs against a likely constructive strategy/dividend update, so p_up 48 gives -0.12; findings sum to -0.1 and the two measurements agree.

already_public.what: 30 June 2026 NAV 60.5p (31 Mar 60.9p), quarterly NAV TR +0.8%, EPRA earnings 0.8p, dividend cover 93%, LTV 37.5%

Q2 (to 30 Sep) dividend target 0.90p per SREIT share (vs 0.897p), first dividend for ex-Picton holders to be declared November 2026; earnings accretion for SREIT in first full year; IMA fee cut 10bp plus one-year fee waiver on Picton NAV; completion LTV ~32%
Picton acquisition completed 11 Sep 2026; enlarged share count 948,471,933 voting shares at 30 Sep

Nine lettings since 5 Aug adding GBP1.2m rent, 11% ahead of June ERV; terms agreed on further GBP1.1m; enlarged portfolio GBP859m, ~GBP51m rent, ERV GBP73m; full strategy update promised for the half-year results

new_in_release.expect: 30 Sep 2026 NAV per share of the enlarged trust: modestly below 60.5p (Q3 market capital values -0.9%, deal costs), roughly 59-60p; down
'future strategy' update for the enlarged trust: disposals/capital recycling to cut LTV, cost synergies, possibly discount-control or buyback language at a ~30% discount; unknown, mild lean up
Q2 dividend declared at the 0.90p target already published; in line, no change expected
IFRS profit likely inflated by acquisition accounting (consideration at ~40p share price vs net assets at NAV); headline noise, NAV per share is the line that matters

TR Property Investment Trust (Ameriprise) lifted its holding to 10.38% from 5.17% at completion (TR-1, 28 Sep 2026). Four directors/PCAs bought GBP12-30k each at 40.1-41.4p on 14-21 Sep 2026.

findings.finding: CBRE's UK Monthly Index puts Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) all-property capital values at -0.9%, industrial -0.9% and offices -1.1% (Outer London/regional offices driving it), with only retail positive (+0.2%); SREI's enlarged portfolio is ~54% industrial and ~25% offices, so the 30 Sep valuation (the first new NAV number in this release) is likely down ~0.5-1%, about 1-1.5% of NAV at ~32% LTV.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SREI's NAV prints move it little: +0.37% on H1 results (2025-11-27), +0.72% on the Dec-quarter NAV (2026-02-26), +1.72% on FY results (2026-06-10), +3.82% on the June-quarter NAV (2026-08-05, mixed with Picton deal news) - Yahoo daily closes.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (Q3 2026 index release; page 403 to both tools, figures from search snippet - snippet_only)
findings.why_not_priced: The macro series is public, so the direction is partly priced; what is not is SREI's own number. If it were priced the stock would have drifted toward a lower NAV-implied level; it is flat over 60 days (+0.6%) at a ~30% discount, consistent with the market not caring much about a 1% NAV move. Hence the small size.
findings.independence: LondonMetric H1 (24 Nov 2026): valuation -0.3% over six months with 18bp yield expansion, and MSCI All Property UK total return ~2.1% for the half (LMP 2.6% = MSCI +50bp), i.e. flat-to-slightly-down capital values: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/londonmetric-property--lmp/half-year-financial-report/9889964

findings.finding: The SREIT exchange ratio was set NAV-for-NAV (raised from 0.881 to 0.894 'to offset SREIT's change in NAV per share from 61.7 pence ... to 60.9 pence'), so the enlarged trust's first NAV per share carries the deal's transaction costs and no NAV accretion to offset them: a small per-share dilution on top of valuations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior SREI print carried deal costs; LondonMetric's H1 the day before showed EPRA NTA/share -1.0% partly on the Picton share issue below NTA, and LMP's stock reaction is not measured here.
findings.why_not_priced: Deal costs were disclosed in the scheme documents but nobody has published the enlarged NAV per share; at a ~30% discount a one-off cost of well under 1p per share matters little, which is why it is sized small and as a one-off.
findings.independence: LondonMetric's H1 NTA bridge shows the Picton share issue and its costs booked in the period: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/londonmetric-property--lmp/half-year-financial-report/9889964

findings.finding: The company has promised that the half-year results will carry 'a full update relating to the Picton portfolio acquisition, portfolio activity, and future strategy', with the manager citing cost synergies and 'capital recycling opportunities to further enhance shareholder returns' and an LTV it has said it wants back inside 25-35%; this is the line not yet seen, and with the board buying at 40-41p and a ~30% discount the incentive is to present disposals and shareholder-return measures.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 14 Oct lettings update (same manager, enlarged-portfolio narrative) was followed by +2.2%, +2.1%, +1.2% over three sessions (Yahoo closes 2026-10-14 to 10-16); no prior SREI strategy reset to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: Its content is unknown, so only the expectation of an update can be priced; the stock has drifted back from 43.65p (4 Nov) to 42.1p, which does not look like a market positioned for a buyback or a dividend step-up. The sign is uncertain, hence the wide range.
findings.independence: Director purchases 14-21 Sep 2026 at 40.1-41.4p (e.g. https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/schroder-real-estate-investment-trust-ltd--srei/director-pdmr-shareholding/9782992); the 2.7's statement of earnings accretion in the first full year and the fee cut.

findings.finding: The October leasing update (GBP1.2m of new rent 11% above June ERV, further GBP1.1m under terms) supports the half's earnings and the 0.90p dividend target, but it is already public and the stock rallied ~5% on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +5.5% over 13-16 Oct 2026 around this release (Yahoo closes), since given back to 42.1p.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: disclosed on 14 Oct and traded on. Filed at 0 under the already-public rule.

findings.finding: Holder base after completion: TR Property (Ameriprise) doubled to 10.38% of voting rights and four directors/PCAs bought on market at 40.1-41.4p, while the disclosed short is only 0.34% (building +0.09pt); the ex-Picton flowback that ran through record volume on 14-18 Sep looks absorbed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: all disclosed two months ago. Small residual because a supportive anchor holder dampens downside on a soft NAV.
